tasks.short: Keep access and security of sensitive materials.

steps.what: Maintain access control for sensitive materials.
Check the security of highly sensitive materials.
Note the access the dispatcher granted.

tasks.design: The dispatcher decides access to sensitive materials and checks their security in person. A note records the access they granted. No rule opens the material on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: Access was a key and a signature, and the reason for opening it sat in the dispatcher's head.
tasks.enabler_now: A note can sit beside the existing lock. It does not replace the lock or the decision.
tasks.still_hard: The materials are highly sensitive, and the reason to open them is specific to the call.
tasks.human_edge: The dispatcher grants access. A note does not open anything.
tasks.altitude: Access and the security check stay with the dispatcher. The note of an access they granted is a small shorter piece.

reach.learn: See an access only after the dispatcher has granted it

evidence.claim: An access note can record who opened sensitive material after the dispatcher decided to grant it.
Opening highly sensitive material is the dispatcher's decision. A rule does not grant it.

assumptions: The workflow starts when someone needs the material and ends when the note is written. The lock and the decision stay manual.
The note fields are who asked, what was opened, and the dispatcher's acceptance. The dispatcher produces the decision. No copy of the material is made.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree.
Upkeep is keeping the list of what counts as sensitive material.
unknowns: What this service counts as highly sensitive material.
Whether a second person must be present when it is opened.
research_questions: What material is highly sensitive at this desk?
Must a second person be present when it is opened?

already_counted.description: Maintaining access control stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the list of what counts as sensitive material

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The conservative case keeps the access decision and the security check in full. The low end moves only the note. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read wanted persons and stolen vehicle records.

steps.what: Open the authorised system for this enquiry.
Read stolen vehicle registration on that system.
Decide what may be said about the stolen property.
Note only what the dispatcher decided to release.

tasks.design: The dispatcher retrieves wanted persons, stolen property, and vehicle registration from the authorised system they already use. They decide what may be said. {OPS_SYSTEM} notes only that decision. No new matcher is built, and nothing is released that the dispatcher did not accept.
tasks.previous_blocker: The lookup was already on an authorised screen. Copying a hit onto the call record was a second typing, and it was easy to copy too much.
tasks.enabler_now: The authorised system remains the place that is searched. The call record can store a short note the dispatcher has accepted.
tasks.still_hard: A hit can be wrong, partial, or not allowed to be said on the radio.
tasks.human_edge: The dispatcher reads the hit and decides what may be released. A search does not make that decision.
tasks.altitude: Reading the authorised system and deciding what may be said stay with the dispatcher. Only the note of that decision is shorter. No new search is added.

reach.task: Hear a hit the desk releases
reach.learn: Hear only what the dispatcher decided could be said

evidence.claim: A short note can store the release decision the dispatcher made after reading an authorised system.
Wanted persons and vehicle records are sensitive. The dispatcher uses the authorised system and does not copy the hit into a new search.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the dispatcher has a name or a plate to check and ends when the accepted release note is stored. The search stays on the authorised system. No new index is built.

The note fields are the enquiry id and the words the dispatcher decided to release. The dispatcher produces those words. The full hit is not copied. If they decide nothing may be said, the note says that and nothing else.

The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree. Entering and updating the external record, where the dispatcher is allowed to do it, stays a direct edit on that system by the dispatcher, not a new tool.
Upkeep is keeping the dispatcher's access to the authorised system, which already exists.
unknowns: Whether the dispatcher may update the external record or only read it.
What from a hit may be said on the radio under national rules.
research_questions: May the dispatcher update the external record, or only read it?
What from a wanted-person or vehicle hit may be said on the radio?

already_counted.description: Retrieving wanted-person information stays inside that step

incremental.description: Keep existing access current; no new search to maintain

approvals.approved_version: release note the dispatcher accepted after reading the authorised system

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the hit must not be copied at all, the note is unused and the low end is the reading and the decision, which stay. No new matcher is introduced in either case. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Scan status and find units available to dispatch.

steps.what: Scan status charts and computer screens.
Contact emergency response field units by radio.
Determine which emergency units are available.
Note the units the dispatcher determined were free.

tasks.design: The dispatcher scans the status board, contacts field units, and determines which units are available. The board is the one the service already has. The dispatcher makes the determination. A note records it. No tool assigns a unit.
tasks.previous_blocker: The board was already on a screen. Availability was confirmed by radio because the board can be late.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing board can be read a little faster. The radio check stays.
tasks.still_hard: A unit can show free and still be unavailable, and the dispatcher has to hear that.
tasks.human_edge: The dispatcher determines availability after contacting the unit. The board does not dispatch.
tasks.altitude: Contacting units and determining who is free stay with the dispatcher. Scanning the existing board is a little shorter.

reach.learn: Tell the dispatcher; the board is not the last word

evidence.claim: An existing status board can be scanned by the dispatcher. Availability is still confirmed with the unit.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a unit may be needed and ends when the dispatcher has determined who is free. Sending the unit is the dispatch task.
The note, if kept, is the unit ids the dispatcher determined. The dispatcher produces them after the radio contact. The board is not copied in as the decision.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree.
Upkeep is small because the board already exists. No second board is built.
unknowns: How often the status board lags the radio.
Whether units must be contacted even when the board shows them free.
research_questions: How often is the status board behind the radio?
Must every unit be contacted before it is treated as available?

already_counted.description: Contacting field units stays in full inside that step

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the board is often wrong, the scan saves little and the low end is the radio contact and the determination, which stay in full. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer routine inquiries and refer other calls.

steps.what: Hear routine inquiries that need no dispatch.
Look up the department that answers this inquiry.
Answer the caller from that department list.
Refer calls not requiring dispatches to agencies.

tasks.design: The dispatcher hears the routine inquiry, looks up a maintained list of departments, answers the caller, and refers calls that do not need a dispatch. The list does not answer, and no tool decides that a call needs no dispatch.
tasks.previous_blocker: The right department was in a directory the dispatcher already knew, and the referral was a transfer.
tasks.enabler_now: A maintained list of departments can be opened while the caller is on the line.
tasks.still_hard: A routine question can turn into an emergency, and the dispatcher has to hear that change.
tasks.human_edge: The dispatcher answers and refers. A list does not decide that a call needs no unit.
tasks.altitude: Opening the department list is shorter. Answering and referring stay with the dispatcher. Nothing answers the caller unattended.

reach.learn: The referral was made by the dispatcher

evidence.claim: A department list can be opened while the dispatcher is on a routine call.
Deciding that a call does not need a dispatch stays with the dispatcher. No tool answers the caller.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the caller asks something routine and ends when the dispatcher has answered or referred them. If it becomes an emergency, it leaves this task.
The list fields are department, hours, and a transfer number. The service maintains them. If a row is missing, the dispatcher says they will find out. The answer is spoken by the dispatcher.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the answer and the referral.
Upkeep is keeping the department list current.
unknowns: Who maintains the list of departments and agencies.
Which inquiries the service still wants handled only by voice.
research_questions: Who keeps the department list, and how often does it change?
Which routine inquiries must stay on a live call?

already_counted.description: Answering the caller stays in full inside that step

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the list is thin, the lookup saves little and the low end is the answer and the referral, which stay. No unattended answer is added in either case. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Access to sensitive material, reading wanted-person and vehicle systems, contacting units, and referring a routine call stay with the dispatcher. No new search is built, and no tool decides that a call needs no unit.
reach: A field unit hears only the hit the dispatcher decided could be said
skills_to_grow: Reading the authorised system without copying the whole hit
Determining unit availability after speaking to the unit
Referring a call only after hearing it
role.ambitious_version: Sensitive lookups stay on the authorised system, and every referral or release was decided by the dispatcher.
